name: ShopSwift
tagline: Grocery and electronics marketplace with its own warehouses and last-mile delivery
summary: ShopSwift sells groceries and electronics across 40 cities from 6 warehouses: catalog, search, cart, checkout, payments, inventory, orders, warehouse management, delivery tracking and notifications. Overselling in flash sales, a stale search index and duplicate warehouse events keep repeating.

tour.headline: Stock is only decremented after payment, so every flash sale oversells; reserving at checkout costs 24 hours.

modules.name: delivery
modules.description: Last-mile routing, ETA and rider app API

modules.name: notifications
modules.description: SMS, push and email to customers

satd: stock decremented after payment, not reserved at checkout
invalidate campaign cache when a campaign changes
nightly full rebuild instead of incremental updates
merge guest cart into account cart on login

incidents.title: Oversold 140 units of a flash-sale phone
incidents.desc: During the 12 PM flash sale 1,140 orders were confirmed for 1,000 phones; 140 customers had to be cancelled and compensated.
whys: More orders were confirmed than stock available
Concurrent checkouts all saw stock as available
Stock is decremented after payment instead of reserved at checkout
incidents.fix: Capped the sale quantity at 90% of stock.
incidents.lesson: A safety margin hides the race; it does not remove it.

incidents.title: Search shows products that were delisted yesterday
incidents.desc: Customers kept finding and adding discontinued items from search results; checkout then failed with 'item unavailable'.
whys: Delisted products appeared in search
The search index is updated only by the nightly full rebuild
There are no event-driven index updates from the catalog
incidents.lesson: The index is always up to a day old.

incidents.title: Delivery ETA shows 'today' for orders placed after the cut-off
incidents.desc: Orders placed after the 6 PM warehouse cut-off were promised same-day delivery; 900 customers got late deliveries.
whys: Customers were promised impossible delivery dates
ETA ignored the warehouse cut-off time
ETA calculation ignores warehouse cut-off times and holidays
incidents.fix: Added a hard-coded 6 PM check in the ETA function.
incidents.lesson: Each warehouse has its own cut-off.

incidents.title: Valid coupons rejected at checkout
incidents.desc: The FESTIVE20 coupon was rejected as 'invalid' for the first 50 minutes of the campaign; support received 2,300 complaints.
whys: Valid coupons were rejected
Coupon validation used an outdated list of active campaigns
Coupon validation reads a stale cache of active campaigns
incidents.fix: Restarted checkout pods to clear the cache.
incidents.lesson: Restarting to clear caches is not a process.

incidents.title: Pick list generated twice for the same order
incidents.desc: Warehouse staff picked the same order twice in Bengaluru; the duplicate was caught at packing.
whys: The same order was picked twice
The order-created event was processed twice
Order events are consumed without de-duplication
incidents.lesson: At-least-once delivery means duplicates will happen.

incidents.title: Payment captured but order stuck in 'payment pending'
incidents.desc: 312 orders showed 'payment pending' although the gateway had captured the money; customers paid again.
whys: Orders showed payment pending after capture
The payment success callback was lost
Order status depends on a single payment callback with no reconciliation
incidents.fix: Updated statuses from the gateway report.
incidents.lesson: Callbacks get lost; we need reconciliation.

incidents.title: Product images broken after CDN migration
incidents.desc: About 8% of product images returned 404 after moving to the new CDN because old URLs were stored in the database.
whys: Product images returned 404
Image URLs pointed to the old CDN host
Absolute CDN URLs are stored instead of asset keys
incidents.fix: Rewrote stored URLs with a script.

incidents.title: 'Shipped' SMS sent before the parcel left the warehouse
incidents.desc: Customers received 'your order has shipped' up to six hours before dispatch because the message triggers on label printing.
whys: Customers got a premature shipped message
The message is triggered by label printing
Notification triggers are tied to internal steps, not customer milestones
incidents.fix: Moved the trigger to the dispatch scan.

incidents.title: Cart total off by one rupee
incidents.desc: Carts with several discounted items showed totals one rupee different from the invoice.
whys: The cart total differed from the invoice
Each line was rounded separately
Rounding rules differ between cart and invoicing

incidents.title: UPI refunds failing for amounts above 1 lakh
incidents.desc: Refunds for returned laptops paid by UPI failed with 'limit exceeded' and were stuck for two weeks.
whys: Large UPI refunds failed
The UPI refund limit is 1 lakh per transaction
Refunds are not split to respect payment-method limits
incidents.fix: Processed the refunds by bank transfer manually.

incidents.title: Hindi product names not found in search
incidents.desc: Searching 'aata' or 'आटा' returned nothing although products exist with Hindi names.
whys: Hindi queries returned no results
The index uses an English-only analyzer
Search has no multilingual or transliteration support
incidents.fix: Added synonyms for the top 50 grocery terms.

incidents.title: Orders confirmed for items that were already out of stock
incidents.desc: In the Diwali sale 400 orders for air fryers were confirmed after stock ran out; the warehouse could not fulfil them.
whys: Orders were confirmed without stock
Concurrent checkouts all saw stock as available
Stock is decremented after payment instead of reserved at checkout
incidents.fix: Lowered the sale cap to 80% of stock.
incidents.lesson: The cap keeps shrinking; the race remains.

incidents.title: Rider app crashes when scanning a damaged barcode
incidents.desc: Delivery partners could not complete deliveries when the parcel barcode was torn; the app had no manual entry.
whys: Riders could not complete deliveries
The app crashed on unreadable barcodes
The rider app has no manual entry fallback
incidents.fix: Support completed deliveries from the console.
incidents.lesson: Every scanner flow needs a fallback.

incidents.title: Search results show old prices after a price drop
incidents.desc: Customers saw the old price in search results and the new price on the product page, and complained of bait pricing.
whys: Search showed outdated prices
The search index is updated only by the nightly full rebuild
There are no event-driven index updates from the catalog

incidents.title: Negative stock after returns processed twice
incidents.desc: A batch of returns was processed twice after a timeout and stock went negative for 40 items.
whys: Stock went negative
Returns were applied twice
Return processing is not idempotent

incidents.title: Customers in Guwahati promised delivery on a local holiday
incidents.desc: Orders from Guwahati were promised next-day delivery on Bihu when the warehouse was closed.
whys: Customers were promised impossible delivery dates
ETA did not know about the local holiday
ETA calculation ignores warehouse cut-off times and holidays
incidents.fix: Added the holiday to a hard-coded list.
incidents.lesson: Hard-coded holidays will miss the next one.

incidents.title: New festive coupon shows 'expired' for the first hour
incidents.desc: The BIGSALE coupon showed 'expired' for an hour after launch; marketing had to resend emails.
whys: A valid coupon showed as expired
Coupon validation used an outdated list of active campaigns
Coupon validation reads a stale cache of active campaigns
incidents.fix: Restarted checkout pods to clear the cache.
incidents.lesson: Second campaign broken by the same cache.

incidents.title: Same order packed and shipped twice
incidents.desc: A Hyderabad order was packed and shipped twice after the warehouse consumer restarted and replayed events; one parcel was lost.
whys: The same order was shipped twice
The order-created event was processed twice
Order events are consumed without de-duplication

incidents.title: Customers charged but orders cancelled after timeout
incidents.desc: Orders auto-cancelled after 15 minutes in 'payment pending' although the payment had succeeded; refunds took five days.
whys: Paid orders were cancelled
The payment success callback was lost
Order status depends on a single payment callback with no reconciliation

incidents.title: Bulk price update job timed out
incidents.desc: The nightly price update for 120,000 SKUs timed out at 2 AM; prices were stale until noon.
whys: Prices were stale
The bulk update job timed out
The job updates one row per statement
incidents.fix: Split the job into four runs.

incidents.title: Flash sale oversold limited-edition sneakers
incidents.desc: The sneaker drop confirmed 260 orders for 200 pairs; the 80% cap did not help because the sale had per-size stock.
whys: More orders were confirmed than stock available
Concurrent checkouts all saw stock as available
Stock is decremented after payment instead of reserved at checkout

incidents.title: Duplicate 'out for delivery' notifications
incidents.desc: Customers received the out-for-delivery SMS two or three times when riders re-scanned parcels.
whys: Customers got repeated notifications
Each rider scan triggers a message
Notifications are not de-duplicated per milestone

incidents.title: Cart items disappear after logging in on another device
incidents.desc: Customers who built a cart as guests lost it after logging in on the app.
whys: Cart items disappeared
The guest cart was replaced by the account cart
Guest and account carts are never merged

incidents.title: EMI options missing for some credit cards
incidents.desc: Customers with SBI and Axis cards did not see EMI options on orders above Rs 10,000.
whys: EMI options were missing
The EMI eligibility list was outdated
Bank EMI rules are maintained by hand

debts.title: Reserve stock at checkout with expiring holds
debts.desc: Atomically reserve quantity when checkout starts and release it on payment failure or timeout.
debts.cause: Stock is decremented after payment instead of reserved at checkout

debts.title: Load tests for flash-sale concurrency
debts.desc: Simulate 5,000 concurrent checkouts against a staging copy before every sale.

debts.title: Event-driven search indexing from catalog changes
debts.desc: Publish product and price changes and update the index within a minute.
debts.cause: There are no event-driven index updates from the catalog

debts.title: ETA service with warehouse calendars and cut-offs
debts.desc: Per-warehouse cut-off times and holiday calendars feeding every ETA.
debts.cause: ETA calculation ignores warehouse cut-off times and holidays

debts.title: Invalidate the coupon cache when a campaign changes
debts.desc: Publish campaign updates and evict the active-campaign cache immediately.
debts.cause: Coupon validation reads a stale cache of active campaigns

debts.title: Idempotent order-event consumer in the warehouse
debts.desc: Store processed event ids and skip duplicates.
debts.cause: Order events are consumed without de-duplication

debts.title: Payment reconciliation job for order status
debts.desc: Every 5 minutes, reconcile pending orders against the gateway and fix statuses.
debts.cause: Order status depends on a single payment callback with no reconciliation

debts.title: Split refunds to respect payment-method limits
debts.desc: Refund engine knows per-method limits and splits automatically.
debts.cause: Refunds are not split to respect payment-method limits

debts.title: Multilingual and transliteration search analyzer
debts.cause: Search has no multilingual or transliteration support

debts.title: Store asset keys instead of absolute CDN URLs
debts.desc: Build image URLs at read time from asset keys.
debts.cause: Absolute CDN URLs are stored instead of asset keys

debts.title: Manual entry fallback in the rider app
debts.desc: Let riders type the order code when a barcode cannot be read.
debts.cause: The rider app has no manual entry fallback

debts.title: Idempotent return processing
debts.desc: Return ids are applied to stock exactly once.

debts.title: Merge guest and account carts on login
debts.desc: Combine carts with quantity rules when a guest logs in.
debts.cause: Guest and account carts are never merged

debts.title: Batch writes in the bulk price update job
debts.desc: Use multi-row updates and run in chunks.
debts.cause: The job updates one row per statement

debts.title: Milestone-based notification rules with de-duplication
debts.desc: Notify only on customer milestones, once per milestone.
debts.cause: Notifications are not de-duplicated per milestone
